[issue by Official-V-Zer0]
### Bug Description

So I am working on a new pack after encountering this issue once before, And Sodium extra and Reese's settings needed the most recent update so you see. No supplementaries. Funnily used to run fine kinda with the alphas

quote the crashlog:
java.lang.RuntimeException: Sodium mod config not found
        at TRANSFORMER/sodium@0.8.12-beta.1+mc1.21.1/net.caffeinemc.mods.sodium.client.config.ConfigManager.registerConfigs(ConfigManager.java:119) ~[net.caffeinemc.sodium-neoforge-0.8.12-beta.1+mc1.21.1-mod.jar%23337!/:?] {re:mixin,re:classloading}

### Reproduction Steps

Download the beta for neoforge
launch game
not even get past the red colored loading screen
crash

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
You have many other mods that are not loading correctly (Create, SoundPhysics) and that is causing NeoForge to abort mod loading, which then causes Sodium to never load its config files. Since we need that config file to render the game (and the error screen), it can't get to the point of showing the actual error message.
